messages:
maria: hey @dmitri @sam @tash @lee — small PR up: splits KV serializer to avoid mem spike on large prefix. need runtime & platform eyes + security quick check. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/12345 canary Fri AM. TL;DR: moves serialization off hot path, adds async flush, feature-flagged.

sam: looking now. can you paste perf delta and a perf test? also which routes are affected?

maria: local perf: p95 down ~20ms on big-batch (seq=1024). load test: `./bench --queries 10k --seq 1024` logs attached in PR. affected: candidate-fetch + cache-warm path. will paste perf snippet in PR.

dmitri: sg. any KV eviction implications? does async flush change ordering? if so we need read-after-write tests. add `kv.serialize.async=true` flag in config for canary.

maria: good catch — ordering preserved via sequence numbers. added unit + integration test: `tests/kv/serial-order.test`. config added: ```yaml
kv:
  serialize:
    async: true
```

tash: I can take security review. quick Q: does this add any new surface for untrusted input to influence serialization? any new deserialization endpoints? cite tests for malformed keys.

maria: no new deserialization endpoints. added fuzz tests: `kv_fuzz.py` and reject invalid keys earlier. fuzz run: "rejected 0/10k malformed" logged. details in PR.

lee: infra note: if canary Fri AM, we'll need a brief staging run (30m) beforehand. also will flip metric alert thresholds for the canary to avoid noisy paging. cc @oncall

sec-bot: security checklist queued. ETA 3h.

sam: ok from platform POV — need a quick perf dashboard link and a merge window. canary window: Fri 09:00–11:00 PT? who will own rollback?

maria: I'll own rollback. will post runbook and the exact revert command in PR. can tag @dmitri for quick revert assist.

dmitri: :thumbsup: will be available 09:00–10:30 PT.

tash: I have one minor note re: key sanitization but non-blocking — will add comment in PR.

maria: thanks all. scheduling canary for Fri 09:00 PT, adding flag and runbook in PR. ping if you'd rather a different window.
